# Habitinator

> Cross-platform habits, dailies, and to-dos with focus timer and statistics.

Habitinator is a Blazor web and .NET MAUI productivity app. User board data is private and requires authentication. This file describes public surfaces only.

## Product

- [Live app](https://habitinator.app/)
- [Source](https://github.com/kadato/Habitinator)
- [README](https://github.com/kadato/Habitinator#readme)

## Public pages

- `/` shows the landing page. Signed-out visitors sign in, register, or continue as the demo guest.
- `/auth/login` shows the sign-in form.
- `/auth/register` shows the registration form.
- `/auth/forgot-password` starts a password reset. The reset link is emailed.
- `/privacy` states the cookie and data policy. The app uses essential cookies only.

## API, authenticated

- [OpenAPI](https://habitinator.app/openapi/v1.json)
- [API catalog](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Board REST API](/api/board) accepts JWT or cookie auth
- [Health](https://habitinator.app/health)

## MCP, authenticated

- The MCP endpoint is `POST https://habitinator.app/mcp` with Streamable HTTP in stateless mode.
- The endpoint needs a Bearer personal token. Generate one in the app at **Settings**, **AI assistant**, **External AI access (MCP)**. Without the app, call `POST /api/account/mcp-token` with a login JWT.
- Tokens support Full, TrackingOnly, and ReadOnly scopes.
- Items can be targeted by itemId GUID or unique title.
- Dates accept ISO `yyyy-MM-dd` and relative values like `"today"`, `"yesterday"`, and `"tomorrow"`.
- Agent auth guide: [auth.md](https://habitinator.app/auth.md), with registration and token minting steps.
- Server card: [server-card.json](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json), with versions and capabilities.
- Capability catalog: [ai-catalog.json](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json). Agent skill: [SKILL.md](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/agent-skills/habitinator/SKILL.md).
- Copy ready configs for OpenCode, Hermes, Claude, and VS Code directly from that Settings panel.
- Full tool, prompt, and resource reference: [docs/mcp.md on GitHub](https://github.com/kadato/Habitinator/blob/main/docs/mcp.md).

## Privacy

Authentication uses session cookies and optional JWT for native clients. The web app contains no third-party advertising trackers. Read [the privacy policy](https://habitinator.app/privacy).

## Security

To report a vulnerability, read [security.txt](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/security.txt).
